default.notes: A visa must be obtained in advance from a Yemeni embassy; tourist visas for the mainland are rarely issued while the conflict continues, and applications are handled case by case. Socotra visits are arranged through licensed tour operators.

groups.notes: Citizens of Gulf Cooperation Council states have historically entered Yemen without a visa — confirm current practice before travel given the conflict.

IL.notes: Israeli passport holders are not admitted to Yemen, and evidence of travel to Israel in any passport can also lead to refusal.

YE.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Yemeni citizens.
